{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_allow;
        wire [15:0] group_selected;
        wire [15:0] low_terms [3:0];

        genvar g, i, b;
        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] local_input;
            wire [15:0] local_winner;
            wire [3:0] local_code;
            assign local_input = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |local_input;
            if (g == 15) begin : top_group
                assign group_allow[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : lower_group
                assign group_allow[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g] & group_allow[g];

            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin : positions
                wire local_allow;
                if (i == 15) begin : top_position
                    assign local_allow = 1'b1;
                end else begin : lower_position
                    assign local_allow = ~(|local_input[15:i+1]);
                end
                assign local_winner[i] = local_input[i] & local_allow;
                if (g == 0 && i == 0) begin : zero_default
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+i] = group_allow[g] & local_allow;
                end else begin : ordinary_position
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+i] = group_allow[g] & local_winner[i];
                end
            end

            assign local_code[0] = |(local_winner & 16'hAAAA);
            assign local_code[1] = |(local_winner & 16'hCCCC);
            assign local_code[2] = |(local_winner & 16'hF0F0);
            assign local_code[3] = |(local_winner & 16'hFF00);
            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : code_terms
                assign low_terms[b][g] = local_code[b] & group_allow[g];
            end
        end

        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : low_encode
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
        end
        assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_selected & 16'hAAAA);
        assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_selected & 16'hCCCC);
        assign output_encoded[6] = |(group_selected & 16'hF0F0);
        assign output_encoded[7] = |(group_selected & 16'hFF00);
        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    end else begin : general_tree
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline computes a binary priority result through a mux tree and then decodes that result into 256 outputs. This places binary selection, high-fanout encoded nets, and one-hot decoding on the same critical path.",
  "rewrite": "Partition the input into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local highest-set-bit winners and higher-group suppression in parallel. Generate one-hot outputs directly from local winners and group suppression, without passing through the binary encoder. Form the binary result with masked OR reductions of local codes and selected group indices.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce the 2.60 ns baseline arrival by eliminating the encode-to-decode path and limiting priority reductions to two 16-way levels. Actual timing gain and zero slew/capacitance violations require the specified mapping and STA flow; no measured result is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses local winner logic, shared group-valid reductions, and OR-based encoding instead of the full binary-result decoder. Expected to remain below the 8862.124480 um2 cap, but mapped area and buffering costs have not been measured. No storage, latency, or technology-specific cells are introduced.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, arbitrary multi-hot inputs select the greatest asserted index. All-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=256'b1; bit zero is deliberately not gated by input bit zero. Module interfaces and all four parameter declarations/defaults are preserved. Other parameter configurations retain the original padded priority-tree implementation."
}
